description: TraceX deterministic remediation specification for existing synthetic dataset

source_dataset.rule: Preserve existing value. Do not invent values for operational synthetic records.

source_record_reference.rule: Preserve existing value. Do not generate replacements.

scenario_id.rule: Rename the field while preserving every existing value and NULL.

confidence.rule: Normalize existing confidence values to canonical High/Medium/Low representation.

data_origin.rule: Retain as an origin indicator; do not treat it as Provenance_Mode.

relationship_origin.rule: Retain source origin indicator; derive canonical Provenance_Mode separately.

Provenance_Mode.rule: For the current synthetic MVP dataset, operational synthetic records use synthetic-design unless a more specific approved provenance rule applies.

Audit_Reference.rule: Generate a deterministic unique provenance reference from source filename and primary record ID. It must not equal the primary ID, source_record_reference, or Generation_Batch_ID.

relationship_type_tag.rule: Current relationships.csv records have relationship_origin=SYNTHETIC and therefore map to design_synthetic.

communication_events.rule: NULL source/target phone IDs are valid when device-based communication references are present. Do not fabricate phone IDs.

timestamps.rule: NULL timestamps on static relationships are allowed. Do not create timestamps for static relationships.

crime_context.rule: Keep as reference-layer CrimeStatistic data. Preserve source_dataset=01_NCRB_India_2023, source_record_reference, synthetic_flag=false, and data_origin=DERIVED.

identity.rule: Do not reuse identities from benchmark/reference datasets and do not create identity-level joins to external sources.
